stories.name: AI Financing Bubble
stories.blurb: Growing debt and financing strains behind the AI spending boom are raising fears of a market reckoning.

stories.name: Anthropic IPO
stories.blurb: Anthropic is preparing for a massive IPO, meeting investors, expanding its banking and credit lineup, and structuring founder control while launching new models and chip efforts.

stories.name: Amazon delivery expansion
stories.blurb: Amazon is rapidly expanding its delivery and logistics network through new partnerships, services, and infrastructure to compete in the delivery turf war.

stories.name: Qualcomm-Amazon AI Chip Deal
stories.blurb: Qualcomm and Amazon announced a multi-generation partnership to develop custom AI data center chips, sending Qualcomm's stock sharply higher.

stories.name: Amazon Q2 Earnings
stories.blurb: Amazon's stronger-than-expected Q2 earnings, driven by AWS growth and heavy investment, spark a stock rally and debate over whether shares remain a buy.

stories.name: AI data center selloff
stories.blurb: Investors are selling off AI data center and hyperscaler stocks amid political uncertainty and doubts about the economics of massive infrastructure spending.

stories.name: AI spending selloff
stories.blurb: Investors are dumping tech and cloud stocks after disappointing earnings from Amazon and Intel raised fears that heavy AI spending isn't paying off.

stories.name: DoorDash Instacart acquisition
stories.blurb: DoorDash is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire grocery delivery rival Instacart in a roughly $17 billion deal that would reshape the food delivery industry.

past.name: Big Tech AI cloud race
past.blurb: Tech giants like Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle are seeing soaring cloud growth driven by AI, prompting investors to debate which stock is the best buy.

past.name: Musk Delta Starlink feud
past.blurb: Elon Musk is publicly feuding with Delta Air Lines and its CEO Ed Bastian over the airline's refusal to adopt Starlink Wi-Fi, while rivals United and American move to poach Delta customers.

past.name: Amazon AI spending surge
past.blurb: Amazon is dramatically ramping up capital spending on AI and cloud infrastructure, raising investor concerns about the scale of its cash burn even as it reports strong demand for AWS capacity.

past.name: Apple Smart Home Push
past.blurb: Apple is launching a new lineup of smart home devices and partnerships to challenge Amazon and Google in the smart home market.

past.name: Amazon timekeeping change
past.blurb: Amazon is changing how time works, affecting timekeeping globally.

past.name: Amazon Qualcomm AI deal
past.blurb: Amazon is partnering with Qualcomm on AI data-center chips, boosting Qualcomm's stock and validating its data-center pivot.

past.name: Meta Muse vs Amazon
past.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI shopping agent is integrating with Shopify, PayPal, and Shop Pay to challenge Amazon, which is moving to block the rival AI checkout tool from its platform, sparking market reaction

past.name: Amazon ecosystem expansion
past.blurb: A wave of companies are announcing new executive hires, certifications, and platform integrations aimed at serving brands and retailers selling across Amazon and other major marketplaces.

past.name: Big Tech Stock Picks
past.blurb: Investors and analysts are weighing whether to buy, sell, or hold major tech stocks like Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle amid AI-driven market shifts.

18.text: AI stock selloffs and debt concerns are pressuring AI infrastructure players, with analysts warning neoclouds could fail and Big Tech buybacks may pause. Hyperscalers like Amazon with strong cash flows are positioned as winners amid the split.

8.text: Anthropic filed for an IPO of 801 million shares at $70-$78, targeting a roughly $1.27-$1.41 trillion valuation and $58-$64 billion raise, below earlier reports. Amazon, an $18 billion investor, is among the tech giants tied to the listing.

4.text: Amazon is partnering with Uber Eats to give US Prime members $0 delivery fees on restaurant orders of $25 or more, ordered through Amazon's app and website, replacing GrubHub. Amazon also launched a free self-service product feed portal for external stores and agreed to pay $3 million to Arizona Prime members over alleged cancellation dark patterns.

7.text: Qualcomm signed a product deal with Amazon for AI data centers. Talen Energy's growth is supported by an Amazon data center power purchase agreement ramping up.

5.text: Amazon’s AWS revenue grew 39% to $46 billion with record retail margins, but the stock fell after earnings on heavy capital spending and free-cash-flow pressure. Analysts remain bullish, noting Amazon’s P/E fell from 34 to 21.

17.text: Democratic midterm wins in Congress and key states like Texas sparked a selloff in AI data center stocks such as CoreWeave, Nebius, Credo, and Micron over fears of new restrictions. Amazon and other hyperscalers held up better, with analysts arguing a buildout slowdown could actually benefit them.

19.text: Software stocks including Cloudflare, MongoDB, Datadog, JFrog, and Elastic extended a selloff as investors repriced AI-related valuations. Amazon is not mentioned; the story bears on it only as a major cloud and AI infrastructure spender.

20.text: Amazon and Uber now offer Prime members $0 delivery on Uber Eats orders over $25, sending DoorDash shares down 13%. Instacart cites Walmart and Amazon as competitive threats in defending its DoorDash merger, while grocers and analysts describe Walmart and Amazon steadily widening a price gap.

6.text: Microsoft is pre-selling AI capacity and funding data centers from cash, while Big Tech buybacks shrink as AI spending consumes cash. Analysts still favor Amazon long-term and expect its cash flow to rebound as AI bubble fears fade.

16.text: Amazon is projected to spend up to $500 billion annually on AI, per JPMorgan. It has arranged up to $80 billion in secured supplier financing for tech infrastructure after a $34.8 billion quarterly free cash flow outflow.
